import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    x = data[1]
    ch = list(x)

    max_len = 0
    countw = 0
    i = 0
    inside = False
    open_idx = 0
    count = 0

    while i < n:
        if not inside:
            c = ch[i]
            if c == '_':
                i += 1
            elif c == '(':
                inside = True
                open_idx = i
                count = 0
                i += 1
            else:
                wc = 0
                while i < n and ch[i] != '_' and ch[i] != '(':
                    wc += 1
                    i += 1
                max_len = max(max_len, wc)
        else:
            while i < n and ch[i] != ')':
                if ch[i] == '_':
                    if count > 0:
                        countw += 1
                        count = 0
                elif ch[i] != '(':
                    count += 1
                i += 1
            if i < n:
                if count > 0:
                    countw += 1
                i += 1
            else:
                i = open_idx + 1
            inside = False
            count = 0

    print(f"{max_len} {countw}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
